audit.whatIsWrong: Five of the seven level-chart rows contradicted their own reason text. whys[1] says 'this window is yours' under win[1]='Skill'; whys[2] 'your hardest pre-6 punish' under 'Akali'; whys[3] and whys[5] literally open 'Skill window:' under 'Akali'; whys[6] says you still beat her 1v1 under 'Akali'. The packet levelChart (Irelia/Irelia/Irelia/Skill/Akali/Skill/Irelia) matches the prose exactly.
audit.why: Akali has no Twilight Shroud and no Perfect Execution before 3, so levels 1-3 are Irelia's; 4-5 and first item are skill windows; level 6 is hers; the 2-item duel still favours Irelia's reset chain per the mirror's own flag.
audit.corrected: All seven rows set to the packet chart in both layers, ratings re-scored to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why credited Vanguard's Edge with owning level 6 while the content layer (and the flipped chart) give level 6 to Akali. It also used 'his'.
audit.why: Perfect Execution (120/90/60s) is two dashes — an engage and an exit — and pairs with a shroud that is still up. Her all-in at 6 beats a dry Irelia commit.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why rewritten around Perfect Execution's 120s rank-1 cooldown; first item and 2+ items reasons rewritten to Trinity Force and the reset-chain duel.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer never stated the one interaction that decides the lane: Twilight Shroud's untargetability blanks the targeted Bladesurge and on-hit autos but does NOT dodge Flawless Duet, which is a positional zone. The content layer had it; the full layer's dos/donts were generic boilerplate with 'his' throughout.
audit.why: Riot's text: Irelia E sends two blades that converge, damaging and stunning enemies caught between — position-based, no target lock. Akali W makes her 'unable to be selected by enemy spells and attacks'.
audit.corrected: Stated in phases[2].why, phases[3].why and dontsFull[0].d, with Twilight Shroud's 20s rank-1 cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1] was headed 'Build some MR' but its body was the generic passive-stacks trade line.
audit.why: Both her damage abilities scale with Ability Power, so magic resist and tenacity are the actual answer.
audit.corrected: Body rewritten to Mercury's Treads and Wit's End.

audit.whatIsWrong: dontsFull[1] 'Fight her 6 with no MR' carried a body about burning your own ultimate.
audit.why: Perfect Execution's second cast executes below a health threshold.
audit.corrected: Body rewritten to the execute threshold.

edits.before: Q resets through minions are your engine — keep the wave healthy. Only take the trade when Akali's Twilight Shroud is down.
edits.after: Defiant Dance's charge soaks her Five Point Strike and Shuriken Flip, and she has no Twilight Shroud yet to escape the punish.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Akali must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Flawless Duet is a positional zone, not a targeted cast — shroud never dodges it. Stun her last-hit step and Bladesurge in.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Twilight Shroud's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Skill window: Twilight Shroud (20s at rank 1) blanks your targeted Bladesurge and autos — bait it or wait it out before committing.

edits.before: Vanguard’s Edge walls off his disengage and marks the kill. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Akali's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Perfect Execution (120s at rank 1) is her all-in and her exit — two dashes, and shroud is up too. Don't facecheck her at 6.

edits.before: Blade of the Ruined King is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Twilight Shroud's cooldown.
edits.after: Skill window: Trinity Force's Sheen on every Bladesurge reset trades evenly with her Zhonya's-plus-shroud kit.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Akali carry threat 8.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Your reset-chaining duel and the Vanguard's Edge wall still beat her single-target pattern — but end it before her scaling lands.

edits.before: Charge 4 passive stacks on minions, E-stun Akali when his answer is down, and Q-reset through the wave onto the kill.
edits.after: Mercury's Treads plus Wit's End blunt her magic burst; her Q and E both scale off AP, and tenacity cuts her slow.

edits.before: That is Akali's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Shroud blanks your targeted Bladesurge and autos; your blades still land.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Perfect Execution executes below a health threshold — stay above it.

notes: The content layer for this matchup was already strong and I left its prose alone; the damage was entirely in the chart labels and the boilerplate full layer. All seven chart rows were proposed as one paired full+content group. The full layer still says 'his'/'him' for Akali in breakdown.mid, breakdown.feeding, breakdown.late, tradeGood and report[12] — those are pronoun-only fixes below the edit threshold I could make within the length band without changing meaning; worth a champion-level sweep.
